correctness.rationale: The determinant-q integer map (x,y)->(u=x,v=x+qy) bijects lattice points with congruent integer pairs u=v mod q within an N=t+1 (even t) or N=t (odd t) consecutive-integer interval. Counting residue occupancies yields exact all-t formula, including t=0. Constituent polynomials have linear coefficient 2delta/q, forcing any period T even. At odd residue s=q, constant term zero requires r_(q+T)=0, hence q|T. Therefore 2q|T, and the formula supplies 2q, proving minimality; direct facet checks show primitive normals, area 1/q, no facet lattice points.
residual_risks: Only odd q>=3, not a classification of all halfway-lattice polygons; finite check supplemental.
